item.title: Rust unsafe Boundaries
item.description: The borrow checker still runs inside an unsafe block, so two mutable borrows there still give E0499. What unsafe opens is operations the compiler cannot check, such as dereferencing a raw pointer (the Rust Book lists five), and the author has to supply the reason each one is safe. I wrapped split_at_mut in a safe function and implemented Send by hand for a type holding a raw pointer, to see where that responsibility splits. The ninth post in a Rust study series.
